fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patient must be a candidate for concurrent chemoradiation
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Candidate for concurrent chemoradiation is an investigator judgment and procedural requirement.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Presence of measurable disease according to RECIST v1.1
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease by RECIST is a subjective imaging judgment, not a typed kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Adequate organ function
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Adequate organ function without explicit lab cutoffs is qualitative.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Available tissue (archival FFPE preferred) with adequate tumor content ( 20% tumor cellularity)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Tissue availability and cellularity are procedural criteria.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Prior thoracic radiotherapy or prior systemic treatment for stage IIIB/IV NSCLC
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior therapy exclusion details are too broad and complex for a single simple prior_therapy_excluded check.
